integrity.proof_basis: analytic hemisphere-coordinate linearization and quadratic Schur root criterion; exact Jordan algebra

scientific_limitations: Local real-symmetric rank-one eigenspace statement; no global or variable-delay conclusion.
The exact stepsize boundary is a linearized neutral case; nonlinear asymptotic attraction at equality is not classified.
General linear-multistep criteria are established prior tools; related appendices and other research could contain equivalent applications.
Finite numerical checks support but do not replace the analytic proof.
title: Sharp local stability and a Jordan threshold for one-step delayed polar eigensolvers
